summary: Continues type casting examples (int/float round trips) and shows which values are natively boolean: yes, true/True/TRUE, no/No/NO, false/False/FALSE, with yes being the only case-sensitive variant.
questions: Which YAML values does Ansible treat as native booleans?

answer_card.title: Native boolean values
answer_card.answer_md:
Natively boolean (`item is boolean`): `yes`, `true`, `True`, `TRUE`, `no`, `No`, `NO`, `false`, `False`, `FALSE`. `yes` is the only case-sensitive variant listed. Other values can be cast with `| bool` but aren't natively boolean.

Casting a float to int and back to string doesn't round-trip (`a_float | int | string != a_float | string`).
